title: Design System: DigiWorld Welcome UI and Sunset Treehouse

wordmark.purpose: Cream Digi World identity beneath the globe.

slogan.purpose: Exact safety slogan below the wordmark.

tip.purpose: Rotating message in the lower-left popup.

sunset-wordmark.purpose: Butter DIGI WORLD on the opening, scaled with the window, plum-deep outline 15 x scale.

sunset-hero.purpose: Bedroom welcome title over the 3D room; plum-deep outline and warm text shadow.

sunset-title.purpose: Tour card title (32); the inspect popup heading uses 28.

sunset-button.purpose: Menu buttons at 26; Play at 32, tour buttons at 24, tour Pause at 18.

sunset-body.purpose: Cream reading copy: tips and pause note at 21; tour body 22, popup description 20, welcome intro 24.

sunset-caption.purpose: Tour step counter in Cream Muted.

shadows.name: identity-shadow
shadows.purpose: Separates outlined cream identity from the moving neighborhood.

shadows.name: play-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lifts the rectangular Play action above the street.

shadows.name: tip-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lifts the white tip card from the street.

shadows.name: sunset-board
shadows.purpose: Godot StyleBoxFlat shadow size 18, offset (0, 9) under every plum board: popup, tour card, pause panel, tip bubble.

shadows.name: sunset-button-pressed
shadows.purpose: The pressed button sinks (shadow size 4, offset (0, 2)).

shadows.name: sunset-hero-text
shadows.purpose: Welcome hero title; the wordmark and corner mark use the same colour 10px below.

motion.name: welcome-reveal
motion.value: 5.5s welcoming sequence: globe and blur enter in 0.7s; greeting at 0.9–2.9s; two globe and horizontal ring turns; settle at 2.4–3.7s; title at 3.15s, slogan at 3.7s, Play at 4.4s, tips at 4.7s
motion.purpose: Welcomes the player personally, then reveals Digi World and the action in a deliberate sequence.

motion.name: identity-bob
motion.value: 8s sine cycle; y 0 to -4 scaled px
motion.purpose: Keeps the globe and wordmark gently moving.

motion.name: street-preview
motion.purpose: Gives the opening neighborhood more time to breathe.

motion.name: tip-rotation
motion.value: 5s interval; 0.2s fade out and 0.25s fade in

motion.name: identity-flight
motion.value: 0.55s cubic ease-out fade and background blur release; identity y -28 scaled px; corner mark follows after 0.18s
motion.purpose: Clears the welcome identity and sharpens the neighborhood as the flight starts.

motion.name: sunset-button-hover
motion.value: scale 1.05 in 0.18s, back ease-out; back to 1.0 in 0.2s

motion.name: sunset-button-press
motion.value: squash to scale (1.04, 0.93) in 0.06s; release springs back in 0.28s, back ease-out; lip 7px to 2px, label drops 5px
motion.purpose: Tactile press with the click sound.

motion.name: sunset-popup-enter
motion.value: slide from -30px to 0 in 0.32s, expo ease-out; fade in 0.22s; description types in at 70 characters per second
motion.purpose: Inspect popup arrives from the left when the aim lands on a lesson object.

motion.name: sunset-popup-exit
motion.value: fade out 0.14s while sliding to -16px, quad ease-in
motion.purpose: Popup steps aside when the aim leaves an object.

motion.name: sunset-crosshair-bloom
motion.value: exponential approach, rate 14/s; ring radius 5.5 to 17, stroke 2.5 to 4, plum-deep to tangerine; breathes +/-4%; ticks appear above 0.3 bloom
motion.purpose: Signals that the aimed object can be inspected.

motion.name: sunset-card-pop
motion.value: 0.35s scale 0.92 to 1 about the bottom edge with back overshoot; opacity reaches 1 at ~62%
motion.purpose: Tour card arrives at each stop.

motion.name: sunset-pause-open
motion.value: slide in from beyond the left edge in 0.38s, expo ease-out; dim fades in 0.25s; whoosh sound
motion.purpose: Pause panel opens while the room stays visible.

motion.name: sunset-pause-close
motion.value: slide out left in 0.22s, quart ease-in; dim fades 0.22s
motion.purpose: Pause panel leaves on Resume or Esc.

motion.name: sunset-slide-in
motion.value: SunsetUI.slide_in: from (-28, 0) in 0.32s, expo ease-out; fade over 70% of the duration
motion.purpose: Kit helper for the same left-edge entrance.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: Solid coral rectangle with white Play label, soft shadow, and clear keyboard focus; portable preview of the native Godot control.
components.css: .ds-play { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:220px; height:62px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#FF7F42; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:32px; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); cursor:pointer; } .ds-play:hover { background:#FF965E; box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.29); } .ds-play:active { background:#DB522E; box-shadow:none; } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #F9F1DA; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Welcome Identity
components.description: Globe-and-orbit logo with cream Digi World wordmark and the exact cyber-safety slogan over the live street.
components.html:
DIGI WORLD
Become a Cyber Hero. Keep your world safe!
components.css: .ds-identity { text-align:center; color:#FAEFDC; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; } .ds-globe { display:block; width:340px; max-width:100%; height:183px; margin:auto; } .ds-wordmark { margin-top:-8px; font-size:68px; font-weight:700; line-height:1; -webkit-text-stroke:15px #0D2B38; paint-order:stroke fill; text-shadow:0 10px rgba(13,43,56,.35); } .ds-slogan { margin-top:10px; font-size:23px; font-weight:600; -webkit-text-stroke:8px #0D2B38; paint-order:stroke fill; }

components.name: Safety Tip Popup
components.description: Lower-left white card; Godot cycles five safety tips every five seconds.
components.html: Tip: Long passwords are stronger than short ones!
components.css: .ds-tip { width:270px; min-height:98px; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:18px 18px 18px 4px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#12394A; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:21px; font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25); } .ds-tip strong { color:#E4622A; }

components.name: Sunset Primary Button
components.description: Tangerine forward action on an ember lip, with a drawn chevron for Play and Next; squishes on press.
components.html: <button class="ds-sun-btn">Next <svg viewBox="0 0 18 22" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="3,3 14,11 3,19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-sun-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; min-height:52px; padding:12px 30px; border:0; border-bottom:7px solid #c95a1c; border-radius:16px; background:#ff8a3d; color:#241330; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:26px; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(36,10,41,.42); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .18s; } .ds-sun-btn:hover { background:#ffa15c; transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-sun-btn:active { background:#f08239; border-bottom-width:2px; padding-top:17px; box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(36,10,41,.42); transform:scale(1.04,.93); transition-duration:.06s; } .ds-sun-btn:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd166; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-sun-btn svg { width:18px; height:22px; }

components.name: Sunset Secondary Button
components.description: Plum Soft button for pause, sound and quit; same lip, squash and butter focus ring.
components.css: .ds-sun-btn2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:52px; padding:12px 30px; border:0; border-bottom:7px solid #241330; border-radius:16px; background:#553163; color:#fff6ea; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:26px; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(36,10,41,.42); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .18s; } .ds-sun-btn2:hover { background:#694a76; transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-sun-btn2:active { background:#502e5d; border-bottom-width:2px; padding-top:17px; box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(36,10,41,.42); transform:scale(1.04,.93); transition-duration:.06s; } .ds-sun-btn2:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #ffd166; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Inspect Popup
components.description: Plum board docked at the lower left in first person; butter title, cream description, and a tangerine Click to play chip with a drawn mouse.
components.html:
Protect Your Base
Join Pip inside the computer. Build your base and discover how to keep its account safe.
Click to play
components.css: .ds-sun-pop { width:400px; max-width:100%; padding:18px 24px 20px; background:#3b2147; border:2px solid #241330; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(36,10,41,.42); font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; } .ds-sun-pop-t { color:#ffd166; font-size:28px; font-weight:700; } .ds-sun-pop-b { margin-top:8px; color:#fff6ea; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; } .ds-sun-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:14px; padding:5px 14px 5px 12px; border-radius:12px; background:#ff8a3d; color:#241330; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; } .ds-sun-chip svg { width:16px; height:24px; }

components.name: Inspect Crosshair
components.description: Bloomed state: tangerine ring with four butter ticks and the eye badge. At rest it is a cream dot in a small plum-deep ring.
components.html: <svg class="ds-sun-xhair" viewBox="0 0 90 90" role="img" aria-label="Crosshair, bloomed"><circle cx="45" cy="46.5" r="20" fill="rgba(36,10,41,.1)"/><circle cx="45" cy="45" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#ff8a3d" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="45" cy="45" r="3.6" fill="#fff6ea"/><g stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="67" y1="45" x2="74" y2="45"/><line x1="23" y1="45" x2="16" y2="45"/><line x1="45" y1="67" x2="45" y2="74"/><line x1="45" y1="23" x2="45" y2="16"/></g><circle cx="72" cy="74" r="15" fill="rgba(36,10,41,.4)"/><circle cx="72" cy="72" r="13" fill="#3b2147" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M64 72 Q72 63.3 80 72 Q72 80.7 64 72Z" fill="#fff6ea"/><circle cx="72" cy="72" r="2.6" fill="#241330"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-sun-xhair { display:block; width:90px; height:90px; animation:ds-sun-breathe 1.57s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-sun-breathe { 50% { transform:scale(1.04); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sun-xhair { animation:none; } }

components.name: Pause Panel
components.description: Esc panel that slides in from the left edge over a plum dim; Resume is primary and focused.
components.html:
Paused
Take a breather. Your room will wait for you.
Resume
Sound: on
Quit game
components.css: .ds-sun-pause { width:380px; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:34px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; background:#3b2147; border:2px solid #241330; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(36,10,41,.42); font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; animation:ds-sun-slide .38s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-sun-pause-t { color:#ffd166; font-size:52px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; } .ds-sun-pause-n { color:#e9d3e6; font-size:21px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-sun-pause-r { min-height:62px; box-sizing:border-box; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 30px; border-radius:16px; border-bottom:7px solid #241330; background:#553163; color:#fff6ea; font-size:26px; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(36,10,41,.42); } .ds-sun-pause-p { background:#ff8a3d; border-bottom-color:#c95a1c; color:#241330; outline:4px solid #ffd166; outline-offset:5px; } @keyframes ds-sun-slide { from { transform:translateX(-110%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sun-pause { animation:none; } }

components.name: Tour Progress Pill
components.description: Top-centre capsule during the bedroom tour: current stop butter, completed tangerine, upcoming lilac rings.
components.css: .ds-sun-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; width:300px; height:46px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:0 14px 0 22px; background:#3b2147; border:2px solid #241330; border-radius:23px; box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(36,10,41,.42); color:#fff6ea; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; } .ds-sun-pill span { flex:1; } .ds-sun-pill i { width:10px; height:10px; margin:0 6px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid #e9d3e6; border-radius:50%; } .ds-sun-pill i.ds-sun-done { width:11px; height:11px; border:0; background:#ff8a3d; } .ds-sun-pill i.ds-sun-now { width:16px; height:16px; margin:0 3px; border:0; background:#ffd166; }

components.name: Sunset Tip Bubble
components.description: Plum speech bubble in the opening's lower left with one tight corner toward the street; tips rotate every 5s.
components.html: Tip: Long passwords are stronger than short ones!
components.css: .ds-sun-tip { width:270px; height:104px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:12px 18px; background:#3b2147; border:2px solid #241330; border-radius:20px 20px 20px 4px; box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(36,10,41,.42); color:#fff6ea; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:21px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.25; } .ds-sun-tip b { color:#ffd166; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview: The imported globe-and-orbit mark and native Fredoka wordmark greet players over the moving neighborhood. The exact cyber-safety slogan sits beneath. A screen-space blur softens the neighborhood behind the sharp welcome UI, arriving with the words and clearing when Play starts the established camera flight. A small white popup rotates online-safety tips. The neighborhood environment system remains the authority for 3D geometry and materials.
keyCharacteristics: Sunset Treehouse: deep plum boards with warm plum-tinted shadows
Sunset Treehouse: tangerine forward buttons on a squishy lip, butter focus ring
Sunset Treehouse: drawn crosshair that blooms on lesson objects, docked inspect popup

rules.name: The Live Street Rule
rules.body: Keep the neighborhood visible behind the opening interface; its changing scenery is part of the composition.

rules.name: The Tangerine Means Go Rule
rules.body: Tangerine marks only the action that moves the player forward, and progress already made. Pausing, sound, and quitting stay plum.

rules.name: The Warm Board Rule
rules.body: Copy sits on a plum board, or carries a plum-deep outline when it floats over the 3D world (wordmark, slogan, welcome hero and intro).

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses Warm Shadow; never neutral black or grey.

rules.name: The Clear Centre Rule
rules.body: During first-person play, only the crosshair occupies the screen centre. The popup docks lower left; the leader line starts at least 64 px from the centre; the pause panel enters from the left edge so the room stays visible.

dos: Do keep the compact logo, exact slogan, rectangular Play action, and tip popup readable over the moving neighborhood.
Do retain the centered Play action, lower-left tip card, and transition to the small corner mark during flight.
Do build new opening, bedroom, and pause UI from `SunsetUI` (`panel_style`, `style_label` roles, `style_button`) instead of restyling controls by hand.
Do keep a visible butter focus ring and focus the forward action when a screen appears.
Do draw small glyphs in GDScript, as the chevron, mouse icon, and crosshair are.
donts: Don't cover the live neighborhood with a full-screen card on this welcome surface.
Don't apply this interface palette or typography as a replacement for the separate 3D environment system.
Don't place UI in the centre clear zone during first-person play.
Don't use tangerine for secondary actions such as pause, sound, or quit.
